_note: The pet's lines for every Digimon of a stage (PetBrain.stage_key: baby = Fresh and In-Training); his own few (own.json) join them. Rows split at line breaks; at most 3 rows under the name, each must fit DW1's text box (tests: test_pet_lines, tools/check_pet_lines.gd). DW1's font has letters, digits and . , : ; ? ! ' + - = only; two spaces between sentences.
greet:
I'm here.  Let's get
to work.

Ready to go!  Nothing
will stop us today.

Good to see you.
I'll keep watch.
morning:
Morning.  A good day
for training.
night:
It's late.  Rest is
part of training.

Still at it?  Then
I'm with you.

File City's lights are
out by now.
talk:
File City grows with
every friend we find.

I've gotten strong.
Thanks to you.

Nobody gets past me.
Your desk is safe.

I could use a good
meal.  Or two.

Jijimon would be proud
of how far we've come.

The gym's fine, but this
is good training too.

A strong body needs
a strong heart.
praise:
Of course!  Leave it
to me!
scold_unfair:
I did nothing wrong.
You know that.

Hmph.  Unfair, and you
know it.

Bad day?  Don't take it
out on me.
read:
Hmm.  Lots of text.
I'll stand guard.

Is this some kind of
battle plan?
dropped:
Ugh.  I've taken worse
hits than that.
wake:
Hm?  I was resting
my eyes.
ask:
Hey!  You've got a
question waiting.

They need your call.
Don't keep them waiting.
failed:
A setback.  We'll get
it next time.

That failed.  Shake it
off and try again.
game:
To File City!  The
real fight awaits.
hungry:
Feed me and I'll
train twice as hard.
pile_left:
You left that mess
out there.
trained_enough:
That's my limit
on this one today.
evolve_ready:
Power is welling up
inside me...!

I'm ready for the
next stage!
